records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company’s operating revenue increased by 8.6 percent in the third quarter of 2024 compared to the same period in 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase resulted primarily from increases in shipments and tonnage.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The operating ratio (operating expenses divided by operating revenue) was 85.1 percent in the third quarter of 2024 compared to 83.4 percent in the third quarter of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: LTL revenue per hundredweight, excluding fuel surcharge, increased 1.7 percent to $21.75 per hundredweight for the third quarter of 2024 as a result of changes in business mix and pricing actions.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consolidated operating income was $125.2 million for the third quarter of 2024 compared to $128.4 million for the third quarter of 2023.
